item.description:
### Fixed
- An area or the whole screen keeps the windows’ shadows, as macOS’s own screenshots do (macOS 15.2 and later). - Capture Text works again after macOS clears its caches, and is ready right after launch: the first capture no longer waits a minute. - Settings fit on a small screen: a tab taller than the screen scrolls. - Capture Text says so when it couldn’t read the text, instead of a beep.
